PromptsOnboardingPageDescription: Prompt Management helps you centrally manage, version control, and collaboratively iterate on your prompts. Start using prompt management to improve your LLM application's performance and maintainability.
PromptsOnboardingVP1Description: Deploy new prompts without application redeployment, making updates faster and easier
PromptsOnboardingVP2Description: Non-technical users can easily edit prompts in the UI. Developers can optionally update prompts programmatically via the API and SDKs
PromptsOnboardingVP3Description: Client-side caching prevents latency or availability issues for your applications
PromptsOnboardingVP4Description: Track latency, cost, and evaluation metrics across different prompt versions
Prompts.New.Title: Create new prompt
Prompts.New.HelpDescription: Manage and version your prompts in Langfuse. Edit and update them via the UI and SDK. Retrieve the production version via the SDKs. Learn more in the docs.
Prompts.New.ImmutableNote: Prompts are immutable in Langfuse. To update a prompt, create a new version.
